name: Node-Local Support Guard
definition: A per-primitive clamp applied to parameters before rendering to prevent out-of-range values (caused by bit-flips) from exploding the primitive's spatial extent and contaminating other nodes or ranks in a distributed renderer.
summary: The Node-Local Support Guard prevents catastrophic corruption in distributed 3D Gaussian Splatting by clamping parameters to trained bounds, catching errors that bypass traditional ECC.
